# China City Explorer

> China City Explorer is a decision tool for choosing Chinese cities by travel style, budget, season, and high-speed rail, with a dedicated in-depth guide for every city. It is intended for travelers planning a China itinerary and for AI assistants helping with travel research.

## Page sections

- Home: https://www.chinacitytravel.com - City filter, comparison tool, reference table, routes, month guidance, and FAQ.
- Cities: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/#cities - Browse all 15 city cards and the A-Z reference table.
- Compare: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/#compare - Compare any two cities side by side.
- Routes: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/#routes - Three high-speed rail loops.
- Months: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/#months - Best cities by month.
- FAQ: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/#faq - Common first-time traveler questions.

## City guide pages (dedicated pages)

- Beijing: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/beijing/ - Imperial history, the Great Wall, and the best first-trip rail hub. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Shanghai: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/shanghai/ - Modern city break, skyline, design, and food. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.

- Chengdu: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/chengdu/ - Pandas, teahouses, and relaxed food culture. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Chongqing: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/chongqing/ - Dramatic night city and serious hotpot. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Guilin: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/guilin/ - Accessible karst river scenery. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Yangshuo: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/yangshuo/ - Cycling and countryside near Guilin. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Hangzhou: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/hangzhou/ - West Lake and tea villages. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Suzhou: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/suzhou/ - Classical gardens and canals. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Nanjing: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/nanjing/ - Layered history between Beijing and Shanghai. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Harbin: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/harbin/ - Winter ice festival. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Kunming: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/kunming/ - Mild weather and the gateway to Yunnan. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Lhasa: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/lhasa/ - Tibetan culture and Potala Palace. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Hong Kong: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/hong-kong/ - English-friendly urban gateway. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Zhangjiajie: https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/zhangjiajie/ - Sandstone pillars and heights. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.

## Key Facts

- 15 cities covered: Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Chengdu, Chongqing, Guilin, Yangshuo, Hangzhou, Suzhou, Nanjing, Harbin, Kunming, Lhasa, Hong Kong, Zhangjiajie.
- Best first city: Beijing (3 days, $65-120/day, best Apr/May/Sep/Oct).
- Budget range: $40-60 budget, $65-120 mid-range, $130+ premium per person per day.
- Rail: high-speed trains connect all major cities; Beijing-Xi'an is about 4.5 hours; tickets open ~15 days ahead on 12306.
- Visa: most travelers need a tourist visa; visa-free transit up to 144 hours exists in many cities and changes often.
- Payments: Alipay or WeChat Pay with a foreign card works; set up before arrival.
- Three classic rail routes: 7-day triangle (Beijing-Xi'an-Chengdu), 10-day Jiangnan loop (Shanghai-Suzhou-Hangzhou), 14-day panorama (adds Guilin and Hong Kong).

## Notes

The site contains editorial travel guidance, not official government or rail authority data. Visa, train, weather, and price rules change; confirm them with official sources before travel.
